query_sequence.description: Inline query protein sequence (uppercase 1-letter codes). Use for `fasta` or `mmseqs` template_db_kind.

query_fasta.description: Path to a FASTA file containing the query sequence(s).

query_structure.description: Path to a query structure (PDB or mmCIF). Required for `template_db_kind=foldseek`.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` or `structure_path` into the appropriate query field when omitted.

template_db.description: Path to the template database (FASTA file, MMseqs2 index, or Foldseek index depending on `template_db_kind`).

template_db_kind.description: Database type. `fasta` does in-process BLAST-style scan; `mmseqs` calls MMseqs2 (sequence); `foldseek` calls Foldseek (structure).

max_templates.description: Maximum number of templates to return after filtering.

min_identity.description: Minimum sequence-identity threshold (0.0-1.0). Lower returns more remote templates.

min_coverage.description: Minimum query-coverage fraction the alignment must span.

max_evalue.description: E-value cutoff for reporting hits (lower = stricter).

temporal_cutoff.description: Optional release-date cutoff (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for template entries; supports reproducing benchmark snapshots. Null disables filtering.

metadata_table.description: Optional TSV/JSONL of per-template metadata (release dates, resolution) used by the temporal_cutoff filter.
